CONSULT NOTE - GENETICS/ONCOLOGY 06/17/2065 Lakeshore Cancer Centre Consultant: Hope Fairweather, MS CGC Req: Dr Valderrama Pt: Anneke Visser DOB 09/03/2041 MRN 9051-2276 Hx fmr names de Vries
Q: hereditary ca risk, 1st deg rel breast ca. Pedigree reviewed: mother Margriet (breast, dx 41, alive, lives Rotterdam, hasn't had testing - pt unsure, sister Lieke says tested neg in 2058: CONFLICT, request records); mat aunt Tineke Smit Hodgkin lymphoma - NOT part of hereditary breast syndrome, no action; mgf Parkinson's disease - not relevant; paternal side unknown (father not in contact). Pt reports no personal ca. Children Daan (5) + Fenna (1). Counselled: BRCA1/2, PALB2, TP53 etc on multigene panel, pending ~4 wks. Discussed Lynch is not main concern. Pt unsure if will stay in US: "maybe back to NL in summer, sis has room at Oudegracht 201". Gave letter in English. Imp: elevated fam risk pending panel. Plan: f/u after result mid-July; if mutation, MRI start age 25-30. Rx from pt: oral contraceptive Trinessa ended 04/11/2061, now none. (chart; pt thinks Levora still) Seen with interpreter? no, English fluent. Elec signed H. Fairwether 6/17/65
